law: Row id is sport|date|event|market. First print writes open and is never overwritten. Close is the last number before start. A candidate is not a close. A result board is not a close. grade.py computes n. The model does not. Official only if the open beat the close and n is at least 5.
gap: Backfill has no numeric close. pricedN is the only sample. Cover notes are not n. Official stays 0-0 until a row has both prices.
